sql: SELECT o.tenant_id, count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM shop.main.orders sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $1) o JOIN (SELECT sluice_src.id, sluice_src.name, NULL AS email, sluice_src.tenant_id, sluice_src.created_at FROM shop.main.customers sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $2) c ON c.id = o.customer_id AND (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sluice_src.id, sluice_src.name, NULL AS email, sluice_src.tenant_id, sluice_src.created_at FROM shop.main.customers sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $3) customers) > 2 GROUP BY o.tenant_id HAVING count(*) < (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM shop.main.orders sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $4) orders) LIMIT (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sluice_src.id, sluice_src.name, NULL AS email, sluice_src.tenant_id, sluice_src.created_at FROM shop.main.customers sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $5) customers)
